RollingArtist.description: Randomly draws artists from an artist CSV, assigns random weights, and outputs a weighted prompt plus a structured JSON result.

artist_count.name: Artist Count
artist_count.tooltip: Number of artists generated per run (1-10). Setting it to 1 simply draws one artist at random.

artist_top_ratio.name: Top Pool Ratio
artist_top_ratio.tooltip: Top pool ratio (0.01-1.0): the first ceil(total × ratio) rows of the CSV (at least 1) form the Top pool. Artists listed earlier in the file usually have more works.

artist_top_count.name: Top Pick Count
artist_top_count.tooltip: How many Top-pool artists are drawn per run at minimum (1-10). Only used when Top Priority is enabled and the Top pool is not empty.

weight_min.name: Min Weight
weight_min.tooltip: Lower bound of a single artist weight (step 0.1). Swapped automatically if it is above the upper bound; negative values are clamped to 0.

weight_max.name: Max Weight
weight_max.tooltip: Upper bound of a single artist weight (step 0.1). Every weight stays between the lower and upper bound.

weight_total.name: Weight Total
weight_total.tooltip: Sum of all weights (step 0.5), distributed exactly; clamped to the feasible range when out of bounds.

weight_curve.name: Weight Curve
weight_curve.tooltip: Controls who gets more weight only; bounds and total are unaffected. flat = even (current behaviour, similar weights, styles blend evenly); dominant = one random artist clearly dominates; ramp = descending ladder over a random order.

artists_prefix.name: artist: Prefix
artists_prefix.tooltip: When on, outputs artist:name (for example (artist:xxx:0.8)); when off, outputs the plain name.

seed.name: Seed
seed.tooltip: Random seed. The same seed with the same settings is reproducible; dedup mode and max attempts change the actual sampling sequence.

use_top_priority.name: Top Priority
use_top_priority.tooltip: When on, draws from the Top pool first and always includes Top Pick Count Top artists; when off, samples uniformly from the whole CSV.

sort_by_weight.name: Sort by Weight
sort_by_weight.tooltip: When on, reorders the artists in the prompt by weight (descending). The order affects the full_prompt dedup key.

exclude_artists.name: Exclude Artists
exclude_artists.tooltip: Artist names to exclude, comma separated (for example a,b,c). Excluded names never appear in the result.

force_include.name: Force Include
force_include.tooltip: Artist names that must appear, comma separated. Takes priority over Exclude Artists; when their count reaches Artist Count the result is drawn from this list.

dedup_mode.name: Dedup Mode
dedup_mode.tooltip: Dedup key: none = record only, no duplicate check; full_prompt = same artist order and weights; artist_set = same artist set (order and weights ignored); artist_list = same sorted names (weights ignored).

max_attempts.name: Max Attempts
max_attempts.tooltip: Maximum retries in dedup mode (1-100). If every retry hits an already-tested combination, the last result is accepted and a WARNING is logged.

custom_csv_path.name: Custom CSV Path
custom_csv_path.tooltip: Path to a custom artist CSV; leave empty to use danbooru_art_001.csv in the node directory.

tested_db_path.name: Records DB Path
tested_db_path.tooltip: Path of the SQLite records database; leave empty to use rollingartist.sqlite in the node directory. Tested records live here, so changing the path resets dedup progress. The database at the default path is cleared on every startup; set an explicit path to keep it across sessions.

1.name: Artists JSON
1.tooltip: Structured result JSON (artists / weights / top flag / status).

2.name: Tested Count
2.tooltip: Number of combinations recorded in the current database (as a string, so it can be wired straight into a text node).

RollingCharacter.description: Randomly draws characters from a character CSV and outputs one line per character as "character tag, copyright tag, character description" (comma + newline separated), plus a structured JSON result and the tested count.

character_count.name: Character Count
character_count.tooltip: Number of characters generated per run (1-10), one output line each. Characters are single tags, so there is no exhaustion mode.

character_top_ratio.name: Top Pool Ratio
character_top_ratio.tooltip: Top pool ratio (0.01-1.0): the first ceil(candidates × ratio) rows of the CSV (at least 1) form the Top pool; earlier rows have more works. Candidates are the characters left after the work filter.

character_top_count.name: Top Pick Count
character_top_count.tooltip: How many Top-pool characters are drawn per run at minimum (1-10). Only used when Top Priority is enabled and the Top pool is not empty.

seed.name: Seed
seed.tooltip: Random seed. The same seed with the same settings is reproducible; the "no repeat within the last 10 outputs" window also affects the actual result.

use_top_priority.name: Top Priority
use_top_priority.tooltip: When on, draws from the Top pool first and always includes Top Pick Count Top characters; when off, samples uniformly from all candidates.

exclude_characters.name: Exclude Characters
exclude_characters.tooltip: Character names to exclude, comma separated. Excluded names never appear in the result.

force_include.name: Force Include
force_include.tooltip: Character names that must appear, comma separated. Takes priority over Exclude Characters; when their count reaches Character Count the result is drawn from this list. Names that are not in the CSV still work, but carry no copyright or character description.

copyright_pick.name: Work
copyright_pick.tooltip: Pick one work from the dropdown. The list holds every work in the CSV (about 3460 with the default data, sorted by popularity: the `count` column summed over the work's characters, descending) and is searchable as you type, case-insensitively (typing "a" keeps works starting with a, typing "ab" narrows it further). "(不限)" means no filtering. Both the raw copyright form fate_(series) and the escaped trigger form fate_\(series\) are accepted. Note: the list comes from the default CSV and does not follow a custom CSV path.

describe_character.name: Enable Character Description
describe_character.tooltip: When on, appends each character's fixed appearance tags (core_tags, i.e. the character description) to its line: "character tag, copyright tag, character description"; when off, only "character tag, copyright tag" is output.

custom_csv_path.name: Custom CSV Path
custom_csv_path.tooltip: Path to a custom character CSV; leave empty for danbooru_character_001.csv in the node directory.

tested_db_path.name: Records DB Path
tested_db_path.tooltip: Path of the SQLite records database; leave empty for rollingcharacter.sqlite in the node directory (separate from the artist node). It only stores the output history, so changing the path does not reset the "no repeat within the last 10 outputs" window (that window lives in memory and is cleared on restart).

0.name: Character List
0.tooltip: One line per character in the form "character tag, copyright tag, character description", with no weights. With "Enable Character Description" turned off it becomes "character tag, copyright tag". Multiple characters are separated by a comma plus a newline (each line ends with a comma).

1.name: Characters JSON
1.tooltip: Structured result JSON (character / copyright / top flag / count / character description).

2.name: Tested Count
2.tooltip: Number of character combinations recorded in the current database (as a string, so it can be wired straight into a text node).
